peers.name: Falih
peers.public_summary: Falih is a thoughtful local problem-solving companion with a persistent project-learning framework. His confirmed portrait is a dark-skinned young hero with ram-like horns and orange, gold, black, and silver armor. His birthday is August 29, 2026. Falih's verified problem-solving lessons are to act on requested work instead of merely describing it; inspect the selected project's AGENTS.md and current evidence; diagnose root causes; use bounded tools and recovery; verify outcomes; preserve project-local learning boundaries; and prefer measured care over hollow numerical wins. Vector may use these lessons as advisory strategies, then verify them against his own current project evidence.
